evidence.observation: Growth temperature steady at about 750 °C (749.5–750.1) after a brief 760.5 °C overshoot at the ramp-to-growth transition, which settled by t=2760.
Heater power stable at about 46% during growth, consistent with holding temperature; the ramp power rose steadily as expected.
Ar flow within about ±1.3 sccm of the 100 sccm setpoint.
Controller reports running and the readings update consistently.

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge or exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so a seal leak or exhaust blockage cannot be seen directly. Whether growth happened needs characterization after the run (e.g., Raman or optical inspection).
